title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

cards.title: Use case log and prioritization draft

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Meeting notes and authorized workflow inventory.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Extract discrete use cases into ID, outcome, persona, trigger, workflow, data, impact/effort rationale, uncertainty, metric and owner. Cite the notes. Mark suggested ratings provisional. Do not infer feasibility from a one-line request or rank an unverified connector as easy. Present a proposed first wave and reasons to validate with the sponsor.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: Use case log; matrix placement; disputed assumptions; next actions.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: Customer business/technical owners and sponsor confirm priorities.
